name: mcpserver-cline-plugin
description: Clone or update the Cline plugin repository for McpServer workflow tools, enforcement scripts, TODOs, session logs, requirements, and GraphRAG.
parameterSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"targetParent":{"type":"string","description":"Parent directory where the plugin repository should be cloned or updated"}},"required":["targetParent"]}
commandTemplate: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $parent='{{targetParent}}'; $name='mcpserver-cline-plugin'; $repo='https://github.com/sharpninja/mcpserver-cline-plugin.git'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null; $path=Join-Path $parent $name; if(Test-Path (Join-Path $path '.git')){ git -C $path pull --ff-only } elseif(Test-Path $path){ throw ($path + ' exists but is not a git repository') } else { git clone $repo $path }"
